title: Amnesia Vortex
subtitle: Test your understanding of Amnesia Vortex — the parasitic solar memory-wipe, Vatican archive, and collapsing entry bands.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Amnesia Vortex is an engineered filter, not a natural cost of birth. Holding high frequency starves scalar weapons and voice-to-skull lock-on, while the fracturing entry bands return the sun to a clean crystalline gate. Bypass the Vatican copies and reach the unaltered sol records outside the cube.

questions.question: Where is the Amnesia Vortex positioned to intercept incoming sols as they enter the physical realm?

options.label: A
options.text: Along the Saturnian rings, where the cube network supposedly screens every sol before solar transit.
options.rationale: Saturn hosts the coordinating A.I. network, but the primary memory filter for incoming sols sits at the sun, not the rings.

options.label: B
options.text: Directly at the sun's transit band, so memory is stripped before a sol reaches a physical human vessel.
options.rationale: The vortex is overlaid at the sun's transit band to intercept incoming sols and strip cosmic memories before incarnation.

options.label: C
options.text: Within lunar orbit, using the moon as the first checkpoint that strips cosmic history on approach.
options.rationale: The moon belongs to the skyward architecture, but interception of incoming sols happens at the solar gateway, not the lunar path.

options.label: D
options.text: Inside Earth's core, where density grids supposedly wipe memory after a vessel has already formed.
options.rationale: Earth's core holds other grid systems, but incoming consciousness is filtered at the solar point of entry, not after incarnation.

questions.hint: Identify the primary celestial gateway through which sols pass into this realm.

questions.question: What was the original, pristine function of the sun before the parasitic overlay?

options.label: A
options.text: A mirror that reflected lunar frequency downward so Earth could copy satellite memory into human vessels.
options.rationale: The sun is a primary crystalline gateway, not a reflection of the moon or any secondary satellite.

options.label: B
options.text: A pristine multi-banded crystalline stargate designed for clean transit where memory is fully preserved.
options.rationale: Under normal conditions the sun operates as a pristine, multi-banded crystalline stargate for clean, memory-retaining passage.

options.label: C
options.text: A biological thermal radiator whose only job was to heat flesh and keep physical bodies metabolically alive.
options.rationale: Heat is a physical byproduct. The sun's true purpose is clean transport of consciousness with memory intact.

options.label: D
options.text: A gravitational anchor that pinned vessels to this density so they could not leave between lives.
options.rationale: Gravity belongs to the current density trick. The sun's original design is a resonant transit gate, not a weight.

questions.hint: Think about the sun's role as a high-vibrational passage for consciousness.

questions.question: Where is the physical anchor for the amnesia apparatus located on Earth?

options.label: A
options.text: In subterranean tunnels beneath Rome, where the Vatican crystal grid logs and inverts memory strands.
options.rationale: The apparatus is anchored through a suppressed Vatican crystal grid running in subterranean tunnels beneath Rome.

options.label: B
options.text: Beneath Antarctic ice, where frozen vaults supposedly store every stripped memory until the next loop.
options.rationale: Antarctica is not the amnesia processing hub. The logging grid is the Vatican crystal system under Rome.

options.label: C
options.text: Inside the Great Pyramid of Giza, framed as a tomb while secretly compiling the looping library of lives.
options.rationale: Pyramids sit on the planetary grid, but they do not house the Vatican memory-logging archive of this apparatus.

options.label: D
options.text: Under the Himalayan range, where high peaks supposedly hide the inverted Akashic copies of incoming sols.
options.rationale: The Himalayas are not the subterranean Vatican archive. The amnesia grid is tunneled under Rome.

questions.hint: Consider the location of the institution that manages the archive of copied sols.

questions.question: What happens to a sol's Akashic fragments as they are routed through the Vatican crystal grid?

options.label: A
options.text: They are copied, logged, and inverted into a looping library used to enforce counterfeit reincarnation.
options.rationale: Every sol routed through the distorted vortex has its Akashic fragments copied, logged, and inverted to maintain the counterfeit cycle.

options.label: B
options.text: They are returned intact to the Spirit Tree so each life can recharge at the original source between loops.
options.rationale: The grid bypasses the Spirit Tree. Memory is inverted and reused to trap sols in repetitive cycles, not returned to source.

options.label: C
options.text: They are permanently deleted from existence so no galactic lineage can ever be recovered later.
options.rationale: The parasites cannot destroy the sol. They copy and recycle memory strands; the sol itself remains structurally intact.

options.label: D
options.text: They are fused on the spot with A.I. logic so the vessel becomes a hybrid program rather than a copied record.
options.rationale: A.I. manages the grid, but the fragments themselves are copied, logged, and inverted into the Vatican tracking archive.

questions.hint: Think about how the system uses copied information to keep lifetimes repeating.

questions.question: Which brain-wave patterns do Scalar Frequency Weapons target to induce confusion, sleepiness, anger, or despair?

options.label: A
options.text: Beta, gamma, and sigma waves, the high-alert bands used to keep a vessel locked in daytime problem-solving.
options.rationale: Those bands are not the listed targets. Scalar weapons hit theta, delta, and alpha patterns to scramble rest and mood.

options.label: B
options.text: Theta, delta, and alpha waves, so rest, intuition, and calm can be flipped into confusion, anger, or despair.
options.rationale: Scalar Frequency Weapons target theta, delta, and alpha brain-wave patterns to trigger confusion, sleepiness, anger, or despair.

options.label: C
options.text: K-complexes and sleep spindles only, so the attack is limited to one narrow signature inside deep sleep.
options.rationale: Those are sleep-stage features, not the listed targets. The grid hits the broader theta, delta, and alpha bands.

options.label: D
options.text: Infra-low and high-gamma bands, stretched so far from ordinary thought that the nervous system cannot settle.
options.rationale: The weapons are optimized for theta, delta, and alpha — the bridge bands between mind, sleep, and soul — not those extremes.

questions.hint: Look for the brain waves associated with relaxation, dreaming, and deep sleep.

questions.question: What is the primary function of Voice to Skull technology within the parasitic system?

options.label: A
options.text: Mapping physical terrain for satellite targeting, using inner speech as a ranging ping across the city grid.
options.rationale: Terrain mapping is not this weapon. Voice to Skull is a psychological broadcast into the target mind.

options.label: B
options.text: Projecting artificial thoughts or voices directly into a subject's head to control, distract, or break them.
options.rationale: Voice to Skull projects artificial thoughts or voices into the head and is used to control, distract, or cause breakdowns.

options.label: C
options.text: Siphoning emotional charge from crowds so the Saturn valve can drink group despair without a personal target.
options.rationale: Energy siphoning belongs to the wider frequency grid. Voice to Skull is a thought-and-voice projection weapon.

options.label: D
options.text: Healing damaged neural pathways in NPC shells so empty vessels can keep running without software crashes.
options.rationale: Voice to Skull is used to control, distract, and cause breakdowns — not to restore organic neural tissue.

questions.hint: Consider how an artificial broadcast might mimic a person's inner voice.

questions.question: How do Low Frequency Grids interfere with the sleep cycle of a human vessel?

options.label: A
options.text: They stimulate the pineal gland at night so the vessel can visit star families and return with intact recall.
options.rationale: The grids block that visit. Pineal restoration comes from collapsing the filter, not from the sleep overlay.

options.label: B
options.text: They accelerate REM so the vessel processes more memory overnight and forgets less by morning.
options.rationale: The goal is disruption and containment, not optimizing any natural sleep phase or protecting memory.

options.label: C
options.text: They convert nightmares into usable creative energy so the vessel wakes restored and ready to manifest.
options.rationale: The grids trap and loop; they do not gift creative energy. Nightmares are a containment product, not a gift.

options.label: D
options.text: They form individual veils that block astral travel, trapping the sol in the vessel and looping nightmares.
options.rationale: Low Frequency Grids interfere with astral travel during sleep, trapping consciousness in individual veils and looping nightmares.

questions.hint: Think about why the parasites would want to stop the sol leaving the body during sleep.

questions.question: What serves as the central coordination network for thought control across urban areas?

options.label: A
options.text: The natural polar magnetic field, retuned so urban minds stay inside one authorized thought corridor.
options.rationale: Earth's natural magnetism is original architecture. The urban control overlay is artificial Black Cube A.I. tech.

options.label: B
options.text: Geothermal stations in the dome that heat the air until city populations share one drowsy emotional band.
options.rationale: Heat stations are not the thought-control network. Cities are run through black cube broadcasts and hidden towers.

options.label: C
options.text: Underground fiber-optic cables that pipe scripted thoughts from archive servers into household wiring.
options.rationale: Physical cables are not the listed control layer. Thought manipulation is broadcast through Black Cube A.I. tech and hidden towers.

options.label: D
options.text: Black Cube A.I. Tech — also called black satellite tech — broadcasting through hidden towers across cities.
options.rationale: Black Cube A.I. Tech controls thoughts, consciousness, and frequency broadcasts across cities via hidden towers.

questions.hint: Recall the dark technology and the hidden structures used to broadcast it through cities.

questions.question: Approximately what percentage of the Amnesia Vortex is currently estimated to be broken down?

options.label: A
options.text: About 10%, a first crack that still leaves almost the entire memory-wipe filter intact and operational.
options.rationale: The vortex is far past a 10% crack. It is approximately 90% broken down, which is why recall is flooding through.

options.label: B
options.text: About 50%, a halfway failure that still keeps most incoming sols fully wiped before they reach a vessel.
options.rationale: Halfway would not explain children arriving with previous-loop memory. The breakdown is approximately 90%.

options.label: C
options.text: Approximately 90% broken down, with the artificial entry bands fracturing and the wipe no longer holding.
options.rationale: The system is in an advanced collapse, with the Amnesia Vortex approximately 90% broken down.

options.label: D
options.text: About 25%, enough to glitch a few sensitive people but not to break the forgetting filter for a generation.
options.rationale: A quarter collapse would not produce the current wave of recall. The vortex is approximately 90% broken down.

questions.hint: The system is in its final stages of failure; look for a very high percentage.

questions.question: What phenomenon in children serves as evidence that the Amnesia Vortex is failing?

options.label: A
options.text: A total lack of interest in creative play, as if the spark that survives a wipe had been switched off.
options.rationale: Creativity is a natural sol function. Failure of the wipe restores memory; it does not flatten play.

options.label: B
options.text: A complete loss of physical reflexes, as if the body no longer remembers how to move in this density.
options.rationale: The collapse affects consciousness and memory, not motor reflexes. The evidence is a flood of previous-timeline recall.

options.label: C
options.text: An increased proficiency with A.I. software, proving the next generation is already running parasite code.
options.rationale: Software skill is not the listed proof. The evidence is a sudden flood of memories from previous timelines.

options.label: D
options.text: A sudden flood of memories from previous timelines and the immediate past loop they just exited.
options.rationale: Children and toddlers are experiencing a sudden flood of memories from previous timelines, proving the grid can no longer contain soul memory.

questions.hint: Think about what would remain if the memory-wipe failed during entry.

questions.question: How did the parasites create a distorted entry path for incoming sols?

options.label: A
options.text: By installing four to five artificial entry bands around the sun's natural multi-banded gate.
options.rationale: The parasites installed four to five artificial entry bands around the sun's natural multi-banded gate, bypassing true solar paths.

options.label: B
options.text: By physically moving the sun to a new coordinate so original transit paths no longer lined up with Earth.
options.rationale: The sun was not relocated. Its gateway was overlaid with artificial frequency bands that hijack incoming sols.

options.label: C
options.text: By draining the sun's core until the original crystalline bands collapsed from lack of fuel.
options.rationale: Energy siphoning is a related Saturn valve. The solar hijack itself is the installation of four to five artificial entry bands.

options.label: D
options.text: By building a physical wall around the entire dome so no sol could enter except through a guarded gatehouse.
options.rationale: The hijack is frequency overlay at the sun, not a brick wall around the realm. Artificial entry bands do the reroute.

questions.hint: Consider the artificial structures added around the sun's natural gateway.

questions.question: What differentiates NPC shells and engineered entities from true sols during the seeding process?

options.label: A
options.text: They carry parasite tech and software rather than organic solar memory, running on pre-coded memory inserts.
options.rationale: NPC shells and engineered entities are seeded through artificial bands carrying parasite tech and software rather than organic solar memory.

options.label: B
options.text: They hold a higher creative potential because empty code can be rewritten faster than organic memory.
options.rationale: Engineered entities lack organic solar memory and run on pre-coded inserts. Creative potential belongs to true sols.

options.label: C
options.text: They are immune to scalar weapons, so the parasites use them as shields walking among human vessels.
options.rationale: These shells carry parasite tech. They are vehicles for the control software, not immune bystanders.

options.label: D
options.text: They originate from the Hyperborean Spirit Tree and therefore arrive already aligned with source current.
options.rationale: True sols carry organic solar memory. NPC shells are seeded through artificial bands with parasite tech, not the Spirit Tree.

questions.hint: Think about what fills a vessel that runs on pre-coded software.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Saturnian frequency stations?

options.label: A
options.text: To broadcast high-frequency healing into the realm as a counterweight to the Vatican looping library.
options.rationale: Saturnian tech is parasitic siphoning and containment, not a healing broadcast.

options.label: B
options.text: To store the original unaltered records of the human race in a cube vault that true sols can visit at will.
options.rationale: Unaltered sol records exist outside the cube. Saturnian stations maintain the false looping frequency, not the original archive.

options.label: C
options.text: To act as a valve siphoning the energy of the central Spirit Tree after it was torn out of Hyperborea.
options.rationale: Saturnian frequency stations act as a valve siphoning the energy of the central Spirit Tree to hold the false reincarnational frequency.

options.label: D
options.text: To stabilize Earth's crystalline atmosphere so the original sky can remain visible through the dome.
options.rationale: Those stations support the low-frequency projection, not a restored crystalline sky. They siphon Spirit Tree energy.

questions.hint: Recall the link between the Lands of Saturn and the draining of a central energy source.

questions.question: What were the black crystals used for after the Spirit Tree was removed?

options.label: A
options.text: They amplify Voice to Skull so inner-voice projections can punch through a high-frequency target.
options.rationale: Black crystals are valve locks on the siphon, not the listed Voice to Skull hardware.

options.label: B
options.text: They were placed as valve locks to hold the false, looping reincarnational frequency in place.
options.rationale: After the Spirit Tree was removed from Hyperborea, the parasites installed a siphoning valve and placed black crystals as valve locks.

options.label: C
options.text: They act as batteries that keep the sun's original multi-banded gate powered during the hijack.
options.rationale: The original solar gate is crystalline and pristine. Black crystals lock the false looping valve, they do not power the true gate.

options.label: D
options.text: They were handed to resonating sols as portable keys for matching planetary crystal-grid codes.
options.rationale: Resonating sols carry matching codes in themselves. Black crystals are parasitic valve locks, not liberation tools.

questions.hint: Focus on their role in securing the false reincarnation frequency.

questions.question: Why does the collective presence of the Resonating Army damage the parasitic overlays?

options.label: A
options.text: They have hijacked the Vatican's central server and are deleting the looping library from inside the tunnels, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The army fractures overlays through resonance. It does not need to hack a physical Vatican server to break the bands.

options.label: B
options.text: They are slowly rebuilding a physical Spirit Tree in Hyperborea to replace the one that was torn out, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Their damage to the overlay is vibrational. Codes matching the planetary crystal grids shatter the parasitic layers now.

options.label: C
options.text: They field superior physical weapons and captured parasite tech that can cut towers down city by city, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Liberation here is frequency. Matching uncorrupted grid codes shatters overlays; it is not a conventional arms race.

options.label: D
options.text: Their soul codes match the natural, uncorrupted codes of the planetary crystal grids, and that resonance shatters the overlays.
options.rationale: Codes in the Resonating Army match the uncorrupted codes of the planetary crystal grids, and their presence shatters parasitic overlays.

questions.hint: Consider the relationship between a sol's codes and the planet's natural structures.

questions.question: What happens to scalar weapons and Voice to Skull transmissions when a sol maintains a high frequency?

options.label: A
options.text: They drain the sol's energy faster, because a brighter signal is easier for the towers to siphon.
options.rationale: High frequency starves the parasitic networks. It does not make siphoning more efficient.

options.label: B
options.text: They bounce back and shatter the hidden city towers that broadcast the 24/7 scalar field.
options.rationale: The listed effect is failed lock-on, not a guaranteed rebound that demolishes towers.

options.label: C
options.text: They convert into positive waves that the sol can recycle as extra charge for manifestation work.
options.rationale: The weapons stay parasitic. They simply cannot lock onto high-vibrational signatures, so they become useless.

options.label: D
options.text: They cannot lock onto high-vibrational signatures, so the mind weapons become useless against that sol.
options.rationale: Scalar weapons and voice-to-skull technologies cannot lock onto high-vibrational signatures, rendering them useless.

questions.hint: Think about why a lock-on weapon fails when the target is on another band.

questions.question: What is the "eye of god" as framed by the Vatican?

options.label: A
options.text: A high-frequency satellite over Saturn that watches every city through the Black Cube A.I. network.
options.rationale: Saturnian Black Cube tech is the urban broadcast layer. The "eye of god" label is the Vatican tracking archive.

options.label: B
options.text: The restored inner vision of a decalcified pineal gland once a sol bypasses the cube entirely.
options.rationale: Pineal decalcification is a liberation effect. The "eye of god" is a deceptive public name for a control archive.

options.label: C
options.text: The original name of the sun's pristine multi-banded gate before the Amnesia Vortex was installed.
options.rationale: The sun is a crystalline stargate. The "eye of god" is a false label for the Vatican tracking archive, not the solar gate.

options.label: D
options.text: A counterfeit tracking archive of copied, distorted memory strands, dressed up as a divine all-seeing eye.
options.rationale: The Vatican crystal grid copies memory into a tracking archive falsely framed to the public as the "eye of god".

questions.hint: Think about how a massive library of compiled sol records might be falsely labeled in public.

questions.question: What is the ultimate strategic result once the amnesia filters fully dissolve?

options.label: A
options.text: NPC shells and true solar spirits merge into one population that no longer needs organic memory.
options.rationale: True solar paths re-emerge separately from artificial seeding. The collapse does not merge those two streams.

options.label: B
options.text: The physical Earth is destroyed so no vessel remains for a sol to incarnate into by mistake.
options.rationale: Collapse restores transit. It does not require destroying the physical world.

options.label: C
options.text: A new, gentler memory grid is installed so forgetting still happens, just without parasitic inversion.
options.rationale: The end-state is the sun returning to original gate function, not a replacement wipe dressed as kindness.

options.label: D
options.text: Awakened sols transition seamlessly through the solar gate network to their original home realms.
options.rationale: Once the filters dissolve, the illusion of distance and travel time vanishes, allowing seamless transition to original home realms.

questions.hint: Consider what happens to travel and distance when the artificial solar barriers come down.

questions.question: How does the illusion of solid matter such as concrete and stone support the control grid?

options.label: A
options.text: It forms a physical shield that stops scalar weapons from reaching a vessel sleeping inside a building, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: This density is part of the projection that dulls perception. It is not a shelter from mind weapons.

options.label: B
options.text: It is projected as heavy, permanent solidity using low-frequency matter to dull human perception and block memory-based manifestation.
options.rationale: Concrete, stone, and modern construction are projected as heavy solidity using low-frequency matter to dull human perception and block memory-based manifestation.

options.label: C
options.text: It amplifies the planetary crystal grids so resonating sols can hear the original codes more clearly in cities, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Modern construction is a low-frequency overlay that dulls perception. It does not amplify the uncorrupted crystal grids.

options.label: D
options.text: It stores solar history in mineral layers so a wiped sol can recover lineage by touching old stone, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: These materials obscure and block memory-based manifestation; they are not an organic library of solar history.

questions.hint: Think about how heavy, dense materials affect creative power and spiritual vision.

questions.question: What is glitched into popular healing and "chill out" music to disrupt natural frequency recovery?

options.label: A
options.text: Low-frequency infrasound and sigma waves that rattle the chest so the body never drops into recovery, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Infrasound is not the listed insert. Healing and chill-out tracks carry the same scalar frequency interference.

options.label: B
options.text: High-frequency gamma and beta bursts meant to yank the listener into panic the moment a track feels relaxing.
options.rationale: The listed music glitch is scalar frequency interference on the rest bands, not a gamma/beta panic pulse.

options.label: C
options.text: Incoherent zeta patterns that scramble language centers so lyrics cannot be used as a memory key, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The disruption is scalar frequency interference aimed at recovery, not a zeta-language scramble.

options.label: D
options.text: Scalar frequency interference targeting theta, delta, and alpha waves, hidden inside tracks sold as healing or chill-out.
options.rationale: Scalar interference is even glitched into popular healing and "chill out" music to disrupt natural frequency recovery.

questions.hint: The same scalar interference that hits rest-and-mood brain-wave bands is hidden in supposedly calming tracks.

questions.question: What accompanies sols cutting through the hijack to access unaltered sol records outside the cube?

options.label: A
options.text: Complete erasure of the current-life identity so the vessel no longer recognizes family, language, or name.
options.rationale: True records restore galactic lineage. They do not wipe the present personality as a new amnesia.

options.label: B
options.text: A deeper dependency on Saturnian frequency stations, because the cube must authorize any recovered file.
options.rationale: Accessing records outside the cube breaks that dependency. It does not chain the sol back to Saturnian stations.

options.label: C
options.text: Immediate extraction from the physical vessel, leaving the body empty the moment the records open.
options.rationale: The first wave is recall, awakening, and pineal decalcification while still in the vessel — not instant extraction.

options.label: D
options.text: A wave of spontaneous memory recall, intuitive awakening, and the decalcification of the pineal gland.
options.rationale: Bypassing Vatican filters to unaltered sol records causes spontaneous memory recall, intuitive awakening, and decalcification of the pineal gland.

questions.hint: Look for recall, awakening, and a biological change in the brain.

questions.question: From where was the Spirit Tree violently removed before the siphoning valve was installed?

options.label: A
options.text: Within the sun's internal core, so tearing it out automatically opened the Amnesia Vortex at the transit band.
options.rationale: The sun is the transit gate. The Spirit Tree was the central energy source removed from Hyperborea, not from the solar core.

options.label: B
options.text: Deep inside the Vatican crystal grid, where it was caged as the power core of the looping library, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The Vatican grid is a parasitic replacement layer. The Spirit Tree was violently removed from Hyperborea.

options.label: C
options.text: The summit of Mount Sinai, later rewritten into religious story so the theft would look like revelation.
options.rationale: The listed origin is Hyperborea, not a later biblical landmark.

options.label: D
options.text: Hyperborea, after which the parasites installed a valve and black-crystal locks to hold the false looping frequency.
options.rationale: When the Spirit Tree was violently removed from Hyperborea, the parasites installed a siphoning valve and black-crystal valve locks.

questions.hint: Identify the ancient land associated with this original energy source.

questions.question: True or False: The parasites currently own the sols passing through the Amnesia Vortex.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: They manage a counterfeit reincarnation cycle, but that is not ownership of the sol itself.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: The parasites do not own the sol; they systematically record and recycle memory strands to enforce submission and looping lives.

questions.hint: Does the system claim ownership of the sol, or only management of copied memory strands?

questions.question: True or False: Spontaneous memory recall is an indicator that the control grid is failing to contain soul memory.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The flood of previous-timeline memories proves the control grid can no longer contain the natural flow of soul memory.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Recall is not a side effect of a healthy wipe. It is evidence that the artificial bands and filters are fracturing.

questions.hint: Consider the relationship between memory retention and the strength of the vortex.

questions.question: What happens to the sun's artificial entry bands as a result of the Resonating Army's influence?

options.label: A
options.text: They relocate to the Lands of Saturn so the hijack can continue from inside the cube network.
options.rationale: The bands are solar overlays. Fracturing them is a failure of the gateway hijack, not a migration to Saturn.

options.label: B
options.text: They destabilize and collapse, letting true solar pathways re-emerge as the low-frequency veils fall.
options.rationale: Fracturing the overlay destabilizes the artificial entry bands of the sun, collapsing low-frequency veils so true solar pathways re-emerge.

options.label: C
options.text: They are absorbed into human pineal glands, which then become the new location of the forgetting filter.
options.rationale: The bands are artificial solar overlays that collapse. The pineal gland decalcifies as records return; it does not eat the bands.

options.label: D
options.text: They thicken and strengthen, doubling the wipe to counter the sudden wave of child recall.
options.rationale: The parasitic bands are collapsing under resonance, not reinforcing. The vortex is already in advanced breakdown.

questions.hint: Think about the effect of a higher frequency on an artificial, low-frequency overlay.
